edition_angle: Exploring the pivotal role of non-cortical brain structures and neural circuits in early neurodegeneration and cognitive maintenance.

assignments.angle: Examine how early volumetric and gene activity changes in the hypothalamus challenge the view of it as a mere bystander in Alzheimer's disease pathogenesis.
assignments.reason: Provides a robust, peer-reviewed primary finding on hypothalamic involvement in early Alzheimer's, aligning well with our focus on brain health and neurodegeneration.
